easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Doppelganger.
description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Vesuvan Doppelganger enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Vesuvan Doppelganger. Choose to have Vesuvan Doppelganger enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
